Is North India really stealing from South India?
The South pays more taxes than it gets back. The North gets more money than it contributes. Southern leaders are furious. Northern voters feel unheard. And underneath it all, a constitutional time bomb planted in 1976 is about to go off.
This isn’t a simple story of one side being right. It’s a story of policies that destroyed the East, a literacy revolution that built the South, and a population freeze that’s about to reshape Indian democracy forever.
